findings.message: Verdict: APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS — 8 blocking conditions and 9 advisories, none showing resolution evidence. BLOCKING-01 (establish a design baseline) is demonstrably open: all 10 ADRs remain Status: Proposed, 0 Accepted, carrying 38 conditions + 6 open blocking actions (44 gating items). BLOCKING-03 (Principle 19 licensed-capability test) gates ADR-005, ADR-006, ADR-007 and ADR-008 and has not been run.
findings.action: Close the 8 blocking conditions and record resolution evidence, or schedule a follow-up review. Start with BLOCKING-03 (run the Principle 19 test once across ADR-001/002/003/006/008) since four downstream decisions depend on it.

findings.message: Total requirements: 64. Not referenced by any ADR: 9 — FR-001, FR-003, FR-006, FR-008, FR-010, FR-012, INT-006, INT-007, NFR-P-002. HLDR ADVISORY-03 already tracks FR-003, FR-006, FR-008 and FR-012; FR-001, FR-010, INT-006 and NFR-P-002 are not tracked anywhere.
findings.action: Review whether these requirements need architectural decisions documented as ADRs. FR-001, FR-010, INT-006 and NFR-P-002 are untracked by both ADRs and the HLDR advisories.

findings.message: Total requirements: 62. Not referenced by any ADR: 62 (all). The project has no decisions/ directory and no ADR artifacts at all, despite holding REQ, EVAL, SOW, DATA, RISK, TRAC and ANAL artifacts. Requirement governance currently rests on ARC-002-TRAC-v1.1 alone.
findings.action: Run /arckit:adr to record the architectural decisions implied by the completed evaluation and SOW, or confirm in ARC-002-TRAC-v1.1 that traceability-matrix coverage is the intended governance route for this project.

findings.message: Total requirements: 55. Not referenced by any ADR: 29 — including the entire NFR set (NFR-A-003, NFR-C-001..003, NFR-I-001..002, NFR-M-001..003, NFR-P-001..003, NFR-SEC-001..004, NFR-U-001..002) plus BR-003, BR-004, BR-006, BR-007, DR-004, DR-005, FR-014, FR-015, INT-003, INT-006, INT-009. The single ADR (ARC-003-ADR-001) covers the functional and integration core but no non-functional requirement.
findings.action: Run /arckit:adr for the non-functional decisions (security, performance, maintainability) — no ADR currently owns any NFR in this project.
